p: Fore Street is the busy north London high street that runs up from Tottenham towards Edmonton Green, lined with Turkish grocers, cafés, barbers and takeaways, and it's always got something going on.

Tottenham Hotspur Stadium is only a short way south along the same road, so on match days the whole area fills up and the buses and Silver Street trains get rammed. Plan around kick-off if you want an easy journey. Pymmes Park, with its lake and walled garden, is a short walk away if you fancy a breather. Admiral is an adult gaming centre, which means 18+ only. Food-wise, Fore Street is a great spot for a proper grill or a Turkish breakfast.
